tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Sanity-check a vendor's or sender's domain before trusting an email, link or payment request. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_check · Private data: domain_check · Public sink: domain_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_check · Private data: domain_check · Public sink: domain_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
